source: Hopper H100. ZXNAME0000XZ documents a 50 MB L2 cache and a 256 KB combined L1/texture/shared-memory capacity per ZXNAME0001XZ, with up to 228 KB configured as shared memory. H100 SXM product specifications list 80 GB ZXNAME0002XZ and 3.35 TB/s memory bandwidth.[5][7]
